en.html:
The world divided into two.

Meaningful. Meaningless.

Meaning belonged to the enemy at the zenith.

Everything else had none.

Information was discarded. Thought was worn away. I heard the human parts of the thing called Kageaki Minato crumbling away.

Intellect ran backward.

Reason lost its way.

Feeling ran everywhere.

en.html:
Pursue the means.

...The means.

What was the best way to bring down the enemy?

Silver Star. Fastest of the fast. A flash descending from the highest sky.

How to surpass that godlike blow...

Technique?



Read the breathing, measure the distance, prepare the most effective counter for the attack the enemy was expected to make. Study the enemy thoroughly, correct the plan as conditions changed, wait—and when the moment came, realize the greatest chance of victory with the greatest effort...



————No.

That very quibbling was useless.

I had been made to understand it already. Useless.



Refine a technique to any extent: against that, useless.

Offer peace negotiations to a starving beast already pouncing at you. The same thing. Nothing accomplished. All effort wasted. Turning and turning, going nowhere.

No use for deception.

To beat that thing, I had to exceed it in pure strength.

No technique required.

Brute strength required.

————Speed.

In the end, speed.

Speed.



Speed was the source of the enemy's strength.

With it, she attacked one-sidedly. Brought me down in one blow. Won without injury.

Speed.

Take away that one advantage, and I could win.

Faster than her, and I would attack one-sidedly. Bring her down in one blow. Win without injury.

Speed!

Speed!

To seize that advantage............by force————

ja.html:
手段の追究。

　……手段。
　敵騎を撃墜し得る方法の最善なるは如何に。
　敵は最速の中の最速を極める銀星号。
　超々高空より閃光と成って降り来たる。
　入神の域にあるその一撃を上回るには……
　
　術技か。


　呼吸を読み間合を測り推定される敵騎の攻撃内容に
対して最も有効な対応術策を用意、敵情を入念に把握
し変化に応じて修正を加えつつ待機のすえ戦機に至ら
ば最高の勝利可能性を最大の努力で実現する……


　
　　　　　　　　　　　――違う。

　そんな<ruby>屁理屈<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>こそ益体も無い。
　既に思い知らされている。無駄だ。


　どれほど突き詰めた術も技も、あれには無駄なのだ。
　飢えて襲い来た野獣に和平交渉を申し出るに等しい。
全くの無為。全くの徒労。全くの空回りだ。

　<ruby>ごまかし<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>は通用しない。
　あれに勝つには、純粋に力でもって上回るしかない。

　<ruby>術技<rt>アーツ</rt></ruby>は要らない。
　要るのは<ruby>剛力<rt>フォース</rt></ruby>だ。
　　　　　　　　　　　――速度。

　とどのつまりは速度。
　速度なのだ。


　敵の強さの根源は速度にある。
　これあればこそ敵は一方的に襲い、一撃にて墜とし、
無傷にて勝利する。

　速度だ。
　この優越さえ奪えば勝てる。
　我が彼より速ければ、我こそが一方的に襲い、一撃
にて墜とし、無傷にて勝利できる。

　速度！
　速度！

　その優位を…………強奪するには――――

en.html:
The armor magnetized.

Under OS's control, its polarity changed continually. Like and opposite poles, their properties used as the movement required.

Effective in armored flight too.

Every stage of its complex motion was optimized—and speed leaped.

Vertical ascent. The least favorable condition. Even there, without giving way, we gained speed.

But not enough.

Still slower.

One more level.

More force—

More speed, or no defeating the enemy.

Force!!

ja.html:
甲鉄が磁化を遂げる。
　その極性は<ruby>村正<rt>ＯＳ</rt></ruby>の統御の下で常に流動するものだ。
同極のそして対極の磁力特性が動作目的に沿って利用
される。

　騎航においてもそれは有効である。
　複雑な運動工程の全てに渡って最適化が施され――
かくして速度は跳ね上がる。

　垂直上昇という最も不利な条件下にあって、屈さず、
速力を増す。
　
　しかし、足りない。

　これではまだ劣る。
　もう一段。

　力を――
　速さを積み重ねなくては、敵に勝てない。

　力!!

en.html:
Force swirled.

A raging torrent.

Shinki—gravity.

Silver Star's ability.

I had used it before. But what I called upon now was far stronger than that time.

Taken from Silver Star through the egg...

Not originally mine's ability. Too great for us.

Like riding a wild horse without reins. The force desperately tried to throw me.

Writhed. Raged. Resisted to the end.

en.html:
Even so, we subdued it.

Two of us.

By force.

Seize it by the scruff, haul it close, turn it toward the course I wanted.

Force that wanted to rage without direction became speed.

Speed.

Nothing else was asked of it.

Nothing else—so I would wring that much out of it, whatever it took.

I crossed some barrier.

The world went away from around me.

As though its patience had ended. As though spitting out that it would accompany me no further.

One man, I was thrown into the void.

No————someone was still here.

One other.

In this void cut off from the world by transcendent speed.

何かの壁を越えた。

　俺の周囲から、世界が去ってゆく。
　愛想を尽かした様子で。これ以上は付き合っていら
れない、と吐き捨てて。

　俺は唯一人、虚空に投げ出された。
　
　いや――――まだ、いる。

　もう一人。
　速度の超越によって世界から隔絶した、この虚空に。
